issues: No sign of gaming the measurement. Scaffold weights come only from train_smiles. Nothing touches test labels, files or the network.

No bug that makes the result meaningless. The weights are 1/sqrt(scaffold size), normalised to mean 1, and both RF and LGBM accept sample_weight. Only the training molecules get weights. The rank-averaged predictions on test_smiles are computed the same way as before.

The numbers support the reject. The candidate's 0.0951 is worse than the incumbent mean of 0.0893, so scaffold down-weighting did not help here. Recomputed: z = -(0.0951-0.0893)/(0.0049*sqrt(1/1+1/2)) ≈ -0.97. The harness reports -0.954; the gap fits rounding of the reported means.
Minor: MurckoScaffoldSmiles has no guard against unparsable SMILES. The run shows no crash, so this did not matter here.
